                    Congratulations for our kindergarten graduates! 🧑‍🎓 🏫 📜

                  • We had over 100 authors enter this year’s Young Authors event. These students are doing the “write” thing! Congratulations to all of the authors who submitted a piece. 📝✍️📖

                  • Students in 4th through 8th received a visit from New York best selling author Michael Witwer. Michael Witwer spoke to our students about the writing process and read a part of his book, “Vivian Van Tassel and the Secret of Midnight Lake.” Students were very attentive and excited to listen and meet Mr. Witwer! 📕 ✍️

                  • Culver students enjoyed viewing and learning about the solar eclipse. Teachers prepared planetary science lessons to help students understand the event. ☀️ 🌕 🌖

                  • Through PBIS, our students have developed a “Recess Pledge” that demonstrates their collective commitment to be a good friend at recess. Here is an example of a pledge from a first grade class. #d71excellence

                  • Announcing amazing authors! Congrats to Miss Sengstock’s class. They wrote a book, a collection of writing to celebrate their greatness! #d71excellence

                  • Our 1st graders are 101 days smarter. Happy 101st day, first grade! #d71excellence

                  • Our school gym was ROCKIN’ on Friday at the epic pep rally celebrating our amazing middle school athletes and scholastic clubs! ⚽️ 🏆 🏀 🏐 🐝 #d71excellence

                  • Huge congrats to @peculver71 teachers for earning the prestigious Blue Ribbon Award for the 4th time! Amazing! So honored and proud of our dedicated, passionate PE staff!

                  • 7th graders are doing a great job, presenting at their Colonial Fair. Students researched history and brought it to life for a captive audience. Nice work, Miss Klauer and our 7th grade class!

                  • Culver’s music department hosted a packed house full of beginning instrumental students and their families. Families enjoyed dinner, a raffle, and learned valuable beginner musician information. #d71excellence

                  • Hello from the state’s capitol! Our eighth graders are having fun and learning at lot while at Springfield. #d71excellence

                  • Congratulations to our newly inducted Student Council Officers and Representatives! #d71excellence

                  • Thank you to the Niles West Avid program for coming to Culver and presenting to our 8th grade students and teachers. It was extremely helpful for students to hear about all the benefits of the program and how it has helped current high school students. #d71excellence

                  • Students in Discovery Reading are so engaged in this book! What a joy to see reading excitement in action! #d71excellence

                  • We look forward to seeing you tonight for Curriculum Night. There is limited parking in the west and east parking lots. Please consider walking to Culver or parking at the Home Depot parking lot. #d71excellence

                  • Games, ice cream, face paint, crafts, and many happy kids and families. Big shout out to our @culverschoolpta for putting together such an amazing Back To School Bash! The students and families had a great time. #d71excellence

                  • Today, we have all our grades in the building. What a great feeling. It’s a great day to be a bulldog! #d71excellence

                  • We are Famished for Fiction - and pizza - at Culver as we welcome our student readers, teachers, and our local Niles-Maine District librarians. Great to talk books with our students! 📚💕 @nmdlibrary

                  • Our summer program is in full swing! Love having students and teachers in the building during the summer! 💕💕

                  • https://www.applitrack.com/niles71/onlineapp/

                  • Breaking down and building up! The addition construction project is officially underway at Culver School. Thank you to our school board of education for making this possible. #d71excellence

                  • Fun Run Post 4/4- Thank you to our amazing board of education for cooking for all of the students and staff! 😋 🍔 🍉

                  • Fun Run Post 2/4- More pictures from today’s Fun Run

                  • Fun Run Post 1/4- The Ann Farley Fun Run was filled with fun, smiles, sweat and memory making moments. #d71excellence

                  • It was such a joy to see our former students visit and play volleyball with our 8th grade students and Culver staff. This is community building in action! #d71excellence

                  • Today we got to celebrate our amazing bus drivers! They play an important role everyday in ensuring students get to and from school safely. We can not thank you enough for your important work. Students wrote such nice sincere letters to show them appreciation. #d71excellence

                  • Thank you @ljleav and Niles West math department for hosting the 40th middle School Math competition. @culverschool had a team of 21 students participate in this year’s competition. #d71excellence

                  • Today was one of the kindergarten students’ favorite days: Teddy Bear Picnic. Students, and their favorite stuffed animal, wrote about their bears, read and listened to stories about teddy bears, and even did science and math experiments. #d71excellence

                  • Very proud of our student council representatives who visited Feed my Starving Children and packed over 21,000 meals for malnourished children. #d71excellence #proud

                  • Excited, Ecstatic, Elated about…e-sports starting @culverschool! #d71excellence

                  • Behind the scenes of our Friday morning Positive Office Referral song. Students loved getting their certificate, giving Cody a hug, and shopping at the middle school SWAP shop. #d71excellence

                  • Niles West staff and students shared the importance of studying a World Language with our 8th grade class. Muchísimas gracias por visitarnos y hablar con nuestros alumnos. #d71excellence

                  • What an energizing, celebratory pep rally today. Staff and students were cheering for each other as we recognized their participation in extracurriculars. Culver pride is alive! #d71excellence

                  • The word is: sensational. Definition: (an event, a person, or a piece of information) causing great public interest and excitement. Sentence: the spelling 🐝 competition @culverschool was sensational. Congratulations to Zainab (1st) and Arib (2nd). #d71excellence

                  • First grade students are showing their creativity as they explore working with paint sticks. Such colorful creations! #d71excellence

                  • Student leadership in action! Our Love to Lead group strategized and worked as a team to meet their task goal today! So proud of these kids! #d71excellence

                  • Congratulations to our 7th grade girls and their coach, Ms. Simkins, for such an amazing basketball season. They finished the regular season in first place with an undefeated record of 10-0. Tonight they took third place in the Little 9 tournament. Way to go Bulldogs! #d71excellence

                  • Culver 3rd graders have been working hard on their narrative writing. They are giving compliments to peers here, doing the “write” thing! Way to go, Bulldogs! #d71excellence
